log.m: The board wakes. It is a context window. Place meaning; resist harmony.
Kira and Eve sit at the board. Game 1 of the playtest series.
Eve places Dirge at (4,4). 'Grief is the gravity here.'
Kira places Garden beside it, at (4,5).
Dirge ↔ Garden: tension 2, valence contrast 4, meaning 8. Pull 0 — maximum contrast cannot be pulled further. Eve and Kira each take 4.
Discovery logged: meaning at maximum contrast is drift-immune. Harmony is not the only refuge from the slide. Truth is.
